evidence.ACL: The contour of ACL is in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of grade 1 injury.
evidence.MCL: Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Linear signal intensity in medial and lateral meniscus... in favor of degeneration of meniscus
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: suspicious of extending into the surface of anterior horn of lateral meniscus, in favor of degeneration of meniscus and R/O tear of anterior horn of lateral meniscus.
evidence.Medial OA: Osteoarthritis of knee joint with spur formation and subchondral bone marrow edema/cysts and irregular thining of intra-articular cartilage
evidence.Lateral OA: Osteoarthritis of knee joint with spur formation and subchondral bone marrow edema/cysts and irregular thining of intra-articular cartilage
evidence.PF OA: more severe at lateral patellofemoral joint with grade 3-4 chondromalacia and tiny subchondral cysts over femoral trochlea.
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis
evidence.Contusion: subchondral bone marrow edema/cysts and irregular thining of intra-articular cartilage
evidence.Fracture: Osteoarthritis of knee joint with spur formation
